title: Incident occurrence event v1
description: Value of incident.occurrence-recorded messages on topic ops.incidents.events.v1, keyed by incidentId (A-0012). The topic also carries other event types; consumers select by eventType. Consumers must ignore unknown properties; v1 only gains optional properties.

eventId.description: Unique event id; consumers deduplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: Time the occurrence was received, UTC.

incidentId.description: Incident id; equal to the message key.

incidentVersion.description: Current incident version. An occurrence does not change the incident, so several occurrence events can carry the same version.

occurrenceCount.description: Occurrences of the incident including this one. Consumers keep the highest value seen.
